user.title: ORVIBO HomeMate
user.description: Choose how to read your lock. Cloud reads ORVIBO's servers with your account. Local runs a server inside Home Assistant that your lock connects to directly (requires a DNS redirect of homemate.orvibo.com to Home Assistant).

cloud.title: ORVIBO cloud login
cloud.description: Sign in with the same ORVIBO Home account you use in the app.

local.title: ORVIBO local server
local.description: Home Assistant will listen on this port for the lock. Point homemate.orvibo.com at Home Assistant's IP in your DNS (e.g. Technitium), then wake the lock so it connects here.

error.invalid_auth: Login failed. Check your ORVIBO email/phone and password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the ORVIBO server.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This ORVIBO setup is already configured.
